notes: Fetched with WebFetch on 2026-10-13. Blocked by robots.txt: /customer-service/order-shipment-tracking/ and /account/login.html (web.archive.org is blocked for this tool too), so their expect strings come from the real header/footer link labels ("Track Your Order", "Sign In", "Create an Account") plus a generic "Order Number" field label. /sitemap.xml returned a client error and no HTML site map was found, so the sitemap section is built from the department left navigations; /sitemap.html and /customer-service/site-feedback/ (real link is a JavaScript feedback widget) are clone-only pages. Department entries in the live header are JavaScript flyouts (href void); local paths use each department landing URL (/shop/tabletop/ canonicalises to /shop/tabletop-glassware-bar/). /shop/home-essentials/ could not be resolved (redirects to the homepage), so Home Essentials uses a local path with approximate subcategories, as do the Holidays and Gifts menus. Shipping, Key Rewards, gift card, Our Story and Account bodies are client-rendered and were mostly empty in fetches; clone copy summarises banner/meta text and avoids specific rates. Some long faceted sale URLs were shortened to their base path. Sister brands, williams-sonomainc.com, the wine shop, personalized wine and the app store link are off-site and become local summary pages. Product grids (homepage rows, departments, categories, search, product pages, cart and checkout) use the purchasable kitchen assortment in stores/williams-sonoma/shelf.js (real brands, local illustrations); the read-only listings captured from the 2026-10-06 "gta 6" search stay on that search, their product pages and /reference/catalog.
